EMPIRE MAY ENTER—BUT IT MAY NOT RULE
https://blossom.yakihonne.com/65833e4d54ebfb8bd81eba1e8c51ca0a3cddce59dc011c06361d5e33348a5eea.jpeg
Empire’s days are numbered.

Not because order, authority or government have no place in the Kingdom, but because power that declares itself ultimate cannot survive the presence of God.

Daniel says the Kingdom established by God will “break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms,” while itself standing forever. — Daniel 2:44

Revelation announces:

«“The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ.”
— Revelation 11:15»

Yet Revelation does not describe the redeemed world as culturally empty. It says:

«“The kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.”
— Revelation 21:24»

The kings enter—but they no longer occupy the highest throne. Their glory is not destroyed; it is submitted, purified and brought into the Holy City.

The Torah establishes the same boundary around earthly power. Israel may appoint a king, but that king must remain under the Law, continually reading it so that he does not consider himself superior to his brethren or depart from the commandment. — Deuteronomy 17:18–20

The throne is permitted.

The arrogance of the throne is not.

The Qur’an likewise declares that sovereignty is never permanently possessed by an empire:

«“You give authority to whoever You please and remove it from who You please.”
— Qur’an 3:26»

And the final home belongs not to those who seek supremacy, but to those who seek neither “tyranny nor corruption on the earth.” — Qur’an 28:83

These scriptures do not erase every nation, ruler or institution. They erase the illusion that any of them is sovereign in itself.

Empire has no throne in the Kingdom.

But what was once empire may still have a seat—after surrendering its crown, laying down its violence, submitting its wealth to justice and remembering that the ruler remains a brother among the ruled.

The Kingdom does not abolish authority.

It abolishes the worship of authority.

Real industry distributes knowledge, responsibility and risk.

Technomessianism concentrates credit at the top and consequences everywhere else.

The messiah receives the valuation.

Not every modern institution sprang fully formed from Christianity. Western civilisation emerged from a layered inheritance: Hebrew moral tradition, Greek philosophy, Roman law, Christian theology, and later Jewish and Islamic scholarship. 

Yet Christ changed the measure by which institutions could be judged.

He placed the least at the centre.
He made authority answerable to service.
He bound love of God to the treatment of the hungry, the sick, the stranger and the prisoner.

Those teachings did not remain private. Early Christian communities organised care for the poor and sick; monasteries sustained hospitality and learning; hospitals developed through this culture of charity; and medieval schools and universities arose within a deeply Christian institutional world. 

But every institution born from revelation faces the same temptation:

Will it preserve the mission—or preserve itself?

Across two millennia, churches, schools, hospitals, charities and governments have carried parts of Christ’s moral inheritance. They have also accumulated hierarchy, wealth, coercion and bureaucracy. At their best, they turned mercy into durable public service. At their worst, they kept His language while reversing His order.

The contradiction is not that the Messiah failed to lay the foundation.

It is that builders repeatedly placed empire on top of it.

Christ did not leave humanity a bureaucratic machine. He left a cornerstone—and a test:

How do you treat the least?

When an institution protects the person, the family, the poor and the truth, it remembers its foundation.

When it sacrifices them to productivity, prestige or self-preservation, it stands judged by the very word from which it claims descent.

Two thousand years later, the institutions may wallow—but the foundation remains.

Empire repackages a basic human need—the desire to raise your own children and remain present in their lives—as a sacrifice against productivity.

A parent who chooses time with family is told they are falling behind. Children are outsourced to institutions, while adults surrender their best hours to systems that never stop demanding more.

Space-time separation is nothing compared with mind-time separation.

A father and child may live beneath the same roof, yet the empire occupies the father’s attention: the deadlines, the debt, the notifications, the endless obligation to produce.

The family does not merely suffer from distance.
It suffers from displaced devotion.

Technology promised to bring us closer, but an empire of distraction learned to colonise presence itself.

That is why the family still awaits the Messiah—not merely to overcome distance, but to restore attention, presence and right order.

The kingdom begins when the child is no longer competing with the empire for the soul of the parent.

Your smart TV is secretly turning your home into a botnet. That's what researchers found — and LG just announced it's taking action.

More than 42% of apps on LG's webOS store include code that routes internet traffic through your television, effectively hijacking your bandwidth for cryptocurrency mining or other malicious activity. The same vulnerability affects Samsung smart TVs in a quarter of their apps.

LG is responding by suspending any app that uses residential proxy SDKs. "A residential proxy network is not an intended use for LG smart TVs," says the company's SVP John Taylor. Apps found to be in violation will be removed from the store, and developers who don't comply risk having their entire presence on the platform banned.

This isn't just about bandwidth theft. These hidden SDKs operate without user knowledge or consent — including from minors using family devices. Security researchers argue that buried consent prompts are no substitute for proper transparency and oversight.

And LG has another problem: its Windows-based smart TVs have been known to silently install McAfee subscription software through Windows Update, again without explicit user approval.

The industry needs to stop treating consumer hardware as free real estate for bad actors.

"Diamond hands," "HODL," "Never selling," "Paper hands"...

This is not a philosophy at all. It's a liquidity problem disguised with a marketing budget. Bitcoin's order books are shallow, as thin as the biceps of a scrawny accountant wasting away at a desk. Market cap is just the marginal price multiplied by the total supply. That isn't realizable value. That isn't what you actually pocket when you sell. It's a number that only holds true as long as nobody tests it all at once. The cult of diamond hands exists purely to ensure no one tries. But here's the part they never say out loud: In any other asset class on Earth, a 2x return triggers a serious conversation. A portfolio manager calls you, a risk committee meets, you take profits, rebalance the budget, and lock in your gains. That isn't weakness; that's just how investing works.

The main reason the "HODL" cult became a dogma in Bitcoin is that it's no longer "money," but a transparent vehicle for speculation. The ledger on Bitcoin's blockchain is completely public; the entire transaction history, balances, and addresses are trackable and easily linked by anyone. This obliterates fungibility -the most fundamental rule of money. A Bitcoin used in a past transaction deemed "bad" or "illicit" can be blacklisted by exchanges and stripped of its value. Monero (XMR), on the other hand, fundamentally rejects this liquidity illusion and the "never sell" marketing. Monero operates with privacy-by-default. Neither the sender, the receiver, nor the amount transferred can be seen from the outside. There's no need for an artificial "diamond hands" cult in Monero, because it isn't a speculative object to be dumped back into the system for fiat; it is an untraceable, uncensorable technology of true freedom that works exactly as intended, used directly for buying goods and services.

Bitcoin has no cash flow, no dividends, no yield, no earnings reports, and no balance sheet. The only thing resembling a return is the price splashed across screens to fuel the cult's chants, which means the only strategy they can sell you is to hold forever and believe harder. This reality is compounded by the risk of a 75% sudden crash, documented three times in Bitcoin's history -let me repeat that: three times in Bitcoin's history! In those moments, there were no stop-losses, no circuit breakers, and deposit insurance was non-existent. There was only diamond hands and the promise that the line would go back up, and they are still running this circus. Here is the truth they never told Satoshi holders: the HODL strategy made mathematical sense before 2017. The market cap was tiny, and the asymmetry was real. A 10x, 50x, or 100x gain was arithmetically possible without requiring Bitcoin to surpass the GDP of the United States.

While the Bitcoin investor is solely focused on the "price line" going up and forced to "believe harder" to make it happen, the cypherpunk mentality behind Monero seeks asymmetry not in price, but in the balance of power between the individual and authority. As Eric Hughes stated in A Cypherpunk's Manifesto: "Privacy is necessary for an open society in the electronic age. Privacy is not secrecy. A private matter is something one doesn't want the whole world to know, but a secret matter is something one doesn't want anybody to know. Privacy is the power to selectively reveal oneself to the world."

Bitcoin's naked transparency leaves the user at the mercy of states and blockchain surveillance-and-profiling firms like Chainalysis. In Monero, mathematical asymmetry isn't measured by price multipliers, but by the absolute financial privacy your 1 XMR provides against the state's multi-trillion-dollar surveillance apparatus, achieved through Ring Signatures, Stealth Addresses, Ring Confidential Transactions (RingCT), Bulletproofs+, and Dandelion++.

For the technologically and economically illiterate/retarded expecting 10x, 50x, or 100x gains from Bitcoin, I have bad news: That window has closed. A 10x increase at its current market cap requires 20 trillion dollars. That is larger than every economy on Earth combined, except for the United States. The asymmetric first-mover trade is dead. Institutional equilibrium has been reached. Now BlackRock is in the game, bringing ETFs born from the financial tradition of the wretched establishment. The revolution now comes with a management fee, a CEO, a CFO, a board of directors, and so on. A 10x gain is off the table. But the pick-and-shovel merchants won't tell you that (for those unfamiliar, this is a reference to the American Gold Rush, where the real money was made by those selling the tools). Their income depends entirely on you continuing to believe. So instead, they feed you "Diamond hands versus Paper hands," "You're still early," "It's just a cycle," "Keep your faith," and all that nonsense.

I mentioned that "the revolution now has a management fee." This is the ultimate proof of Bitcoin's divorce from its cypherpunk roots. BlackRock, Vanguard, and the rest of the Wall Street bastards have tamed Bitcoin by absorbing it into the system through ETFs. Today, Bitcoin is not a rebel who defies the dominant financial system; on the contrary, it is an institutional financial product that strictly complies with KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations, and one that governments can tax, freeze and seize. Monero, on the other hand, rejects this form of control and bondage by its very nature. Monero can never become an institutional ETF product, because no centralized custodian or Wall Street corporation can regulate a network where they cannot audit transactions, view balances, or identify the actors behind them. While the pick-and-shovel peddlers distract the masses with the "you're still early" lie, the Monero community is building a truly uncensorable, peer-to-peer alternative economy completely outside the system, safe from state printing presses and seizures.

In short, the HODL cult exists because exit liquidity has to come from somewhere, and that liquidity is you. The HODL cult is a strategy designed to trap individual investors inside so that whales and institutions can cash out into fiat at the top. The ultimate goal in the #Bitcoin camp is still to get rich by converting back into Dollars or Euros -the system's fiat slave money. Yet, in Monero and its pure cypherpunk mentality, the concept of "exit liquidity" does not exist. Because in Monero, the goal is not to abandon the system and crawl back to the rulers' currency; Monero itself is the exit from that system. Someone using #Monero does not aim to return to #fiat; they choose to live within a parallel economic order that protects their privacy, freedom, and the value of their labor. A technology of freedom doesn't condemn you to an exchange trading pair; it gives you an independent sovereign space entirely free from the interference of states and banks.

"Diamond hands", yani elmas eller, "HODL", "Asla satmam", "Paper hands", yani kâğıt kadar zayıf eller...

Bu hiçbir şekilde bir felsefe değil. Bu, pazarlama bütçesi olan bir likidite problemidir. Bitcoin'in işlem emri defterleri sığdır, cılız bir muhasebecinin masa başında erittiği pazuları kadar incedir. Piyasa değeri, marjinal fiyatın toplam arz ile çarpımıdır. Bu, realize edilebilir bir değer değildir. Sattığınızda elinize geçecek olan şey değildir. Bu, ancak hiç kimse onu aynı anda test etmediği sürece geçerliliğini koruyan bir sayıdır. Elmas eller tarikatı, kimsenin bunu yapmamasını sağlamak için vardır. Ama işte asla yüksek sesle söylemedikleri kısım şudur: Dünyadaki diğer tüm varlık sınıflarında, 2 katlık bir getiri ciddi bir tartışma konusudur. Bir portföy yöneticisi sizi arar, bir risk komitesi toplanır, kârı alır, bütçeyi yeniden dengeler ve kazancı korursunuz. Bu bir zayıflık değildir; zira yatırım dediğin böyle işler.

Bitcoin'de "HODL" kültünün bir dogma hâline gelmesinin temel sebebi, onun artık bir "para" değil, şeffaf bir spekülasyon aracı olmasıdır. Bitcoin'in blokzincirindeki hesap defteri tamamen şeffaftır; tüm işlem geçmişi, bakiyeler ve adresler herkes tarafından izlenebilir ve kolaylıkla ilişkilendirilebilir. Bu durum, paranın en temel kuralı olan birimdenklik (fungibility) ilkesini yok eder. Geçmişte "kötü" veya "kanunsuz" addedilen bir işlemde kullanılmış bir Bitcoin, borsalar tarafından kara listeye alınabilir ve değeri düşebilir. Monero (XMR) ise bu likidite illüzyonunu ve "asla satma" pazarlamasını kökten reddeder. Monero, temel varsayılan olarak mahremiyetle işler (privacy-by-default). Ne gönderici, ne alıcı, ne de transfer edilen miktar dışarıdan görülebilir. Monero'da yapay bir "elmas eller" tarikatına ihtiyaç yoktur; çünkü Monero sisteme geri satılıp itibari paraya (fiata) dönülecek bir spekülasyon nesnesi değil, takip edilemeyen, sansürlenemez ve doğrudan mal/hizmet alımında kullanılabilen ve tam olarak amaçlandığı şekilde çalışan gerçek bir özgürlük teknolojisidir.

Bitcoin'in nakit akışı yok, temettüsü yok, getirisi yok, kazanç bildirimi yok, bilançosu yok. Tek getiri olarak görülebilecek şey orada burada yazan ve tarikatın nidalarını süsleyen fiyattır; bu da size satabilecekleri tek stratejinin sonsuza kadar tutmak ve daha güçlü inanmak olduğu anlamına gelir. Bu durum, Bitcoin tarihinde üç kez belgelenmiş %75'lik bir âni değer kaybı riskiyle birleşir; tekrar edeyim: Bitcoin tarihinde üç kez! Bu durumlarda hiçbir zaman "Stop loss" olmadı, devre kesici yoktu, mevduat sigortası işlemezdi. Sadece elmas eller ve bu sefer çizginin yeniden yukarı çıkacağına dair verilen söz vardı ve hâlâ bu sirki sürdürüyorlar. İşte Satoshi sahiplerine söylemedikleri gerçek şuydu: HODL stratejisi 2017'den önce matematiksel olarak mantıklıydı. Piyasa değeri küçüktü ve asimetri gerçekti. Bitcoin'in Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nin GSYİH'sini aşmasını gerektirmeden 10 kat, 50 kat, 100 katlık bir değer artışı aritmetik olarak mümkündü.

Bitcoin yatırımcısı sadece "fiyat çizgisinin" yukarı gitmesine odaklanmışken ve bunun için "daha sert inanmaya" zorlanırken, Monero'nun arkasındaki cypherpunk mantalitesi asimetriyi fiyatta değil, birey ile otorite arasındaki güç dengesinde arar. Eric Hughes'un Cypherpunk Manifestosu'nda belirttiği gibi: "Mahremiyet, elektronik çağda açık bir toplum için elzem bir unsurdur. Mahremiyet gizlilik değildir. Mahrem bir mesele, tüm dünyanın bilmesine gerek duymadığınız bir şeydir, ancak gizli bir mesele hiç kimsenin bilmesini istemediğiniz bir şeydir. Mahremiyet, kişinin kendisini dünyaya seçici bir şekilde gösterme gücüdür."

Bitcoin'in korumasız şeffaflığı, kullanıcıyı devletlerin ve Chainalysis gibi blokzincir gözetleme-fişleme şirketlerinin insafına bırakır. Monero'da matematiksel asimetri, fiyatın kaç katına çıkacağıyla değil, çember imzalar (Ring Signatures), gizli adresler (Stealth Addresses), çember gizli transaksiyonlar (RingCT), kurşungeçirmez sıfır-bilgi kanıtları (Bulletproofs+) ve konum gizleyici (Dandelion++) sayesinde harcadığınız 1 XMR'nin, devletlerin trilyon dolarlık gözetim aygıtları karşısında sağladığı mutlak finansal mahremiyetle ölçülür.

Bitcoin için 10 kat, 50 kat, 100 katlık değer artışı bekleyen teknoloji ve iktisat özürlüler için ise kötü bir haberim var: O pencere kapandı. Mevcut piyasa değerinde 10 katlık bir artış 20 trilyon dolar gerektiriyor. Bu, Amerika Birleşik Devletleri hariç dünyadaki tüm ekonomilerden daha büyüktür. Asimetrik ilk hamle ticareti yok oldu. Kurumsal dengeye ulaşıldı. Artık BlackRock da oyunda ve rezil müesses nizamın finans geleneğinin ETF'leri mevcut. Devrimin artık bir idare ücreti, CEO'su, CFO'su, yönetim kurulu vesaire var. 10 katlık artış artık mevcut değil. Ama Kazma-Kürek Satıcıları size bunu söyleyemez (Anlamayanlar için bu Amerika'nın Altın'a Hücum Dönemi'ne bir göndermedir, zira Altın'a Hücum Dönemi'nin asıl kâr edenleri onlardır). Onların geliri, sizin buna inanmaya devam etmenize bağlıdır. Bu yüzden bunun yerine karşınıza "Elmas eller versus Kâğıt eller", "Hâlâ erkencisin", "Bu sadece bir döngü", "İnancını koru", falan filan çıkar.

"Devrimin artık bir idare ücreti var" demiştim. İşte bu Bitcoin'in cypherpunk köklerinden kopuşunun en büyük kanıtıdır. BlackRock, Vanguard ve nice Wall Street sakini piç kurusu, Bitcoin'i ETF'ler üzerinden sistemin içine entegre ederek onu evcilleştirmiştir. Bugün Bitcoin, egemen finansal sisteme kafa tutan bir asi değil, tam aksine, KYC (Kimlik Doğrulama) ve AML (Kara Para Aklamayı Önleme) kurallarına sıkı sıkıya bağlı, devletlerin vergilendirebildiği ve dondurabildiği kurumsal bir finansal üründür. Monero ise bu esareti doğası gereği reddeder. Monero asla kurumsal bir ETF ürünü olamaz; çünkü hiçbir merkezî saklama kuruluşu veya Wall Street şirketi, transaksiyonlarını ve bakiyelerini denetleyemediği, arkasındaki aktörleri göremediği bir ağı regüle edemez. Kazma-kürek satıcısı kitleler "Hâlâ erkencisin" yalanıyla oyalarken, Monero topluluğu sistemin tamamen dışında, gerçek anlamda sansürsüz, devletlerin basamadığı ve el koyamadığı eşler arası (P2P) alternatif bir ekonomi inşa etmektedir.

Özetle, HODL tarikatı var, çünkü çıkış likiditesinin bir yerden gelmesi gerekiyor ve o likidite sizsiniz. HODL kültü, küçük yatırımcıyı içeride tutarak balinaların ve kurumsalların tepeden nakde (itibari paraya) geçmesi için bir "çıkış likiditesi" yaratma stratejisidir. #Bitcoin cenahındaki nihai amaç, yine sistemin kölelik parası olan Dolar veya Euro'ya dönerek zengin olmaktır. Ancak Monero ve onun pür cypherpunk mantalitesinde bir "çıkış likiditesi" kavramı yoktur. Çünkü Monero'da amaç sistemi terk edip egemenlerin parasına geri dönmek değildir; Monero'nun kendisi zaten o sistemden çıkışın ta kendisidir. #Monero kullanan biri, #fiat paraya geri dönmeyi hedeflemez; mahremiyetini, özgürlüğünü ve emeğinin değerini koruyan paralel bir ekonomik düzende yaşamayı seçer. Özgürlük teknolojisi sizi bir borsa paritesine mahkûm etmez; size doğrudan devletlerin ve bankaların müdahale edemeyeceği bağımsız bir yaşam alanı sunar.

　ぼくが参加したときはボート周辺を自由に泳ぐのではなく、ボートから垂らしたロープに参加者全員がロープでビレイしてただひたすら黒潮に流されるってスタイルだった。
　いまは動画や倉田さんの須江ダイビングセンターのサイトを見ると、ビレイまではしていないみたい。
　でも足元は水深 4、500m はあるので、ある程度潜れます、って程度の人はお断りのダイビングになる。
　ぼくが潜ったときも周囲はインストラクターやそれ相当のダイブマスター、アシスタント・インストラクタークラスばかりで (一応ぼくも ITC は通ってしまうだろうって言われてはいたアシスタント・インストラクターではあったので混ぜてもらえた)、アマチュアの人は MSD クラスだった。
　なにせ 5 〜 7 ノットで流れてるし、下は 4、500m だから、もしもがあり得る人は入れられない。
　でもビレイを取らなくなってるってことは、ロープに繋がなくても問題なく行動できるダイバーだけを受け入れることでもしもを防ぐって前提になっているのかもしれない。もちろん自称上級者は危なくてちょっと無理、ってダイビングになる。
